answer: Earning starts only after a private delay chain finishes. New identities wait in a harbor, an intake basin that pays nothing. A falcon ticket, a starting nonce made from that seat's public key, seeds 450 million chained hashes, about 4 core-minutes, that will not split across cores. Forty signed checkpoints are posted on a mesa, a public stair of roots; verifiers recompute two random segments in seconds. Copied tickets fail for a second key, so 500 extra names cost 2,000 core-minutes, sunk up front, caught or uncaught.
